license_note: The weights repository carries two files. LICENSE-MODEL, the MiniMax Model License dated for a model release date of 15 January 2025, grants use, reproduction, distribution, and modification of the Model Materials with a copy of the agreement and a Notice attribution, and incorporates a Prohibited Uses Policy whose items include any military purpose and fully automated decisions that adversely affect legal rights. That policy is a field-of-use restriction, so the release is source-available rather than open source. LICENSE-CODE is a separate MIT license for the repository's code, which is not the represented weights artifact and so is not listed as a record license; the weights remain under the restricted model terms. The model license is governed by Singapore law with SIAC arbitration, and the identical files appear in the GitHub repository.

license_evidence.scope: MiniMax-Text-01 model weights and accompanying materials, including the incorporated Prohibited Uses Policy

access_boundary: This record represents the MiniMaxAI/MiniMax-Text-01 weight release of January 15, 2025, in the original repository (last modified 2025-07-03). The MiniMax-VL-01 vision-language sibling, the transformers-native MiniMax-Text-01-hf conversion, the MiniMax-M1 reasoning release built on it, later MiniMax M-series models, downstream quantizations, and the MiniMax Open Platform are separate boundaries.
strengths: Both licence files sit beside the weights and in the GitHub repository, with the model terms dated by release date
The model card documents a transformers quickstart with int8 quantization and a vLLM deployment guide
tradeoffs: The Prohibited Uses Policy bars military purposes and fully automated adverse decisions, so the licence restricts fields of use
The current MiniMax platform documentation does not list this model, so no first-party hosted endpoint is documented today
